subject: HackSprint: sponsorship credit request for POC/demo
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@scribeai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HackSprint Org <hackathon@devsprint.org>
Date: Thu, May 27, 2026 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: HackSprint sponsorship credit request (POC / demo)

Hey Alex / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow — we just signed up via the self-serve PLG path (company: Scribe AI). The HackSprint team asked if Redwood can provide a sponsorship allocation for our POC team so we can run live demos during the event next week.

Summary: we need ~50k tokens of inference credits (higher-quality models) to run a 4-hour demo slot for up to 12 participants (demo bots + summarization pipelines). This is a one-off event (May 31) but will directly feed into a paid pilot if the demos go well.

Attachments: hackathon_agenda.pdf (event schedule), po_c_slide_deck.pptx (one-page POC plan).

Can you confirm whether self-serve signups are eligible for sponsorship credits and how quickly we could issue them? We have a short turnaround — hoping for a decision within 48 hours.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel | Head of Partnerships | Scribe AI
samir@scribeai.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@scribeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 27, 2026 at 10:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: HackSprint sponsorship credit request (POC / demo)

Hi Samir — welcome and congrats on the signup. Quick clarifying questions so we can triage this internally: 

- Are you on a verified org account or still on the self-serve individual sandbox? (I can see the signup but not the billing status yet.)
- Confirm expected model profile (e.g., redwood-1-large / transformer-bert-xxl) and estimated request pattern (concurrent sessions, avg tokens per session).
- Is Scribe AI running this as an official HackSprint partner demo (i.e., event marketing listing), or is this an independent meetup you’re running on the side?

If you can reply with those two bullets + company URL, I’ll escalate to our sponsorship pool — we have a small fast-path allocation for community hackathons but approvals require manager sign-off. Monica from finance is looped for any billing/credit paperwork.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@scribeai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, HackSprint Org <hackathon@devsprint.org>
Date: Thu, May 27, 2026 at 11:27 AM PDT
Subject: Re: HackSprint sponsorship credit request (POC / demo)

Thanks Alex — details below: 

- Account status: company account created via self-serve on May 26; we completed email verification and added a company domain, but no billing method attached yet. HubSpot form ID: 8723 (linked in email).
- Model: prefer redwood-1-medium for live demos (balanced latency/cost). We estimate 12 concurrent demo sessions, average 400 tokens per session during peak (approx 4 hours of demo traffic plus warmups). Rough total ~= 48k tokens; asking for 50k to be safe.
- Event status: listed as an official partner demo in the HackSprint agenda (attached). The organizer (HackSprint Org) can confirm — they’re CC’d.
- Company URL: https://www.scribeai.com

We can provide the POC slide deck and sponsor shoutout in exchange for credits. Fast turnaround appreciated — Hoping for issuance before end of day Friday so we can finalize our demo scripts.

Best,
Samir
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@scribeai.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, May 28, 2026 at 1:02 PM PDT
Subject: Re: HackSprint sponsorship credit request (POC / demo)

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the attachments. We reviewed the event materials and spoke with the sponsorship committee. Good to support community demos like this.

Approval: Redwood will issue a one-time grant of 50,000 inference tokens to Scribe AI to be applied to the company account (no billing required).

Terms / next steps:
- Grant issued as a promotional credit valid for 60 days from issuance.
- We will add a credit note to your account and email a short confirmation PDF (redwood_credit_note.pdf).
- Please reply with the company billing contact and the preferred account email to attach the credit to (if different from samir@scribeai.com).
- Optional: we’d appreciate a short blurb or logo usage rights for event marketing — will send a separate sponsorship confirmation doc.

Attachments sent: redwood_credit_note.pdf (stub), credit_grant_notice.txt (internal reference).

Alex / Monica — I’ve approved this from the sponsorship pool; Monica, please attach the promotional credit to record DEAL-8723 and confirm the invoice/billing notes.

Samir — congrats, and good luck at HackSprint. If anything else, ping Alex directly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
